artworks.title: Orfeo condotto da Bacco
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a large, ornate ship with various figures onboard. The ship features elaborate decorations, including animal figures and patterns. Orfeo is sitting in an elevated position, while Bacchus stands holding a wine goblet near a barrel. Other figures in Roman attire are present on the deck. A grand structure is depicted at the back of the ship, with foliage and smoke billowing from a vessel at the front. The banner reads "ORFEO CONDOTTO DA BACCO" in Italian. The artwork presents a detailed representation of mythical stories through engravings and movement on the water.

artworks.title: Inconvenient de quitter
artworks.description: This is a painting of two individuals standing on a hill as a train passes by in the background. The scene depicts two figures clad in vintage attire, standing on a small hill or embankment. Their coats and hats are whipped by the wind, suggesting a burst of air, likely from the passing train visible in the background. The train is situated along a curved track, nestled between green vegetation and a cliffside. The sky above is painted with gradient hues transitioning from light to dark shades, with clouds sweeping across. The painting employs soft outlines and muted colors characteristic of satirical or caricature art common in the 19th century. This is in the style of Honoré Daumier.

artworks.title: The Artist's Wife Sewing
artworks.medium: etching with engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image features a bust portrait of a woman. She is seen in a three-quarter view, looking downwards with a tranquil expression. The woman has curly hair under a bonnet, and she wears a shawl, a blouse, and holds a piece of fabric. The background is textured with hatched lines.

artworks.title: Saints Philip and Bartholomew by a Spring
artworks.description: The image depicts two figures in a wooded area examining a fountain. One figure crouches holding a vessel, while the other stands pointing with a knife. Both figures are dressed in robes. The background features trees and a distant tower or building. The image is monochromatic with strong contrasts and varied lines.

artworks.title: The Conversion of Saint Paul
artworks.dimensions: sheet (cut to platemark): 41.2 x 30.9 cm (16 1/4 x 12 3/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene with celestial and terrestrial figures. The scene shows armed individuals engaged in a skirmish on the ground, while a powerful bearded figure emerges from the clouds above, surrounded by small cherubic forms. The drawing is intense, with swirling clouds and strong diagonal lines suggesting movement and conflict. Details in the drawing show the artist's skill in depicting human and animal forms in motion.

artworks.title: Allegory of Intellect, Memory, and Will
artworks.dimensions: sheet (cut within platemark): 54.3 x 37 cm (21 3/8 x 14 9/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image features three primary figures in a detailed engraving. The central figure is seated and partially draped with wings, holding a compass to a tablet or book. To the left, another figure is partially draped with wings showing, and to the right, a third figure is fully draped in robes. Two smaller winged cherubs are also present. The background includes architectural elements, trees, and foliage, all depicted in an engraved style, with decorative elements and inscriptions at the bottom.

artworks.title: The Sudarium
artworks.medium: woodcut in black on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows the head of a man with a crown of thorns. His face is centered on a fabric, tears are flowing from his eyes. He has long, wavy hair and well-defined facial features including a beard and mustache. The crown of thorns is on his head, with droplets extending from it. The fabric is textured with tassels at the corners and appears to be suspended. The background is plain with a neutral tone.

artworks.title: Democritus Meditating
artworks.dimensions: sheet (cut to platemark): 16.1 x 13.1 cm (6 5/16 x 5 3/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a skeletal figure in a sarcophagus with the inscription "VANITAS ET STRVA." The image contains a skeleton lying within a sarcophagus or open coffin, along with symbols of vanity and mortality like a skull and a broken urn. To the right, a goat is next to scattered book pages. In the background are a stone wall and trees. This scene is common in vanitas art, reflecting on the fleeting nature of life and possessions.

artworks.title: Saint John the Evangelist
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing at a desk with a book and quill. The person has curly hair and a focused expression. They wear a loose garment. A large bird is perched on the desk. The background features stone blocks with plants growing from them. The image is depicted with detailed line work.

artworks.title: Max Klinger
artworks.medium: Herkomergravure in black on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a profile view of a man. He is facing to the right, showing his features in a side profile. He has a prominent forehead, a broad nose, and a rounded chin. His hair seems to be short and thick with a slightly wavy texture. The image is monochromatic with dark and light contrasts. There are no visible clothing details as they are rendered in shadow. The name "Klinger" is visible in the lower part of the image. The background is a textured dark surface.

artworks.title: Le Coup de Lance
artworks.artist: Boëtius Adams Bolswert after Sir Peter Paul Rubens
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a crucifixion scene. The image depicts three figures on crosses. The central figure is crowned with thorns. The figures around them show expressions of sorrow and anguish. Shadows and light are used to enhance the scene. There is detail in the drapery and anatomy of the figures. Below the central scene, there is an inscription in Latin. The sky is dark and tumultuous.

artworks.title: Mountain House
artworks.medium: woodcut in black on blotting paper
artworks.description: The image shows a scene from an elevated angle, looking down at a small rustic structure in lush vegetation. The composition features swirling clouds, bold lines, and intricate patterns, creating a dynamic and energetic atmosphere. The color palette is monochrome with stark contrasts between black ink and white paper. The vegetation is depicted with vigorous strokes, conveying wildness. The hut appears partially hidden by the vegetation and intense sky.

artworks.title: Narcissus at the Spring
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a reclining figure in a pastoral setting. The image depicts a figure lying down with one arm rested back on a grassy surface and the other arm holding a curved staff or shepherd's crook. The figure is surrounded by lush foliage, including tall trees and dense bushes, creating a feeling of a forest or garden area. In the foreground, a dog can be seen resting beside the figure. The style is characterized by intricate linework and hatching.

artworks.title: Four Bacchic Children
artworks.description: This is a drawing of cherubic figures interacting in a natural setting. The scene portrays three winged figures with soft, rounded bodies, engaging with each other and their surroundings. The figures are set against a backdrop of trees, and one of them appears to hold a branch or vine, possibly exchanging it with another. The composition features intricate line work, emphasizing the texture of the figures' hair and the foliage. It has an intricate cross-hatching technique that creates depth and texture. The setting conveys a serene, idyllic environment with a hint of classical or mythological influence in its depiction.

artworks.title: Diana Recumbent
artworks.description: The image depicts a reclining figure, naked and in a relaxed pose. The figure is partially lying on their back and partly supported on their side. The right arm is placed behind their head, legs are bent at the knees, and the person's facial features appear serene. The background shows trees with foliage, suggesting an outdoor setting. A dog is lying nearby, and two additional figures are partially obscured by the trees in the distance.

artworks.title: A Leg and a Pig's Head
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with red chalk and graphite on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a human figure in a side-profile view from the upper thigh down, including one leg. The figure appears to be standing. Facial features, hair, clothing, or specific objects are not detailed. Surrounding the figure are additional light sketches of an animal head and abstract shapes. The background has a lightly speckled paper texture, indicating this may be from a sketchbook or similar document.

artworks.title: Gobbi and Other Bizarre Figures
artworks.medium: pen and iron gall ink with a partial sketch in graphite at upper left on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a collection of sweeping, curving lines and irregular shapes forming an abstract composition. The lines intersect and flow across the canvas. Some shapes loosely resemble distorted human faces and figures, possibly wearing hats, with hints of figures in motion or masks with exaggerated expressions. The overall effect is a dynamic scattering of forms that encourages viewers to find familiar shapes within the chaos.

artworks.title: Plant Study with Burdock
artworks.description: The image shows various large, intricately detailed leaves dominating the composition. Some smaller plants and foliage are visible at the bottom and sides of the image. The color palette is mainly grayscale, typical of an etching, creating a monochromatic scheme with variations in shading and contrast for depth and texture. The largest leaves are centralized in the image, with smaller vegetation at the bottom and a tree-like silhouette on the left side.

artworks.title: Café-Concert
artworks.medium: pastel over monotype and charcoal (in sticks of fan) on tan laid paper and board
artworks.dimensions:
actual: 9 1/4 x 17 in. (23.5 x 43.2 cm)
framed: 16 1/8 x 24 in. (41 x 61 cm)
artworks.description: Six women wearing off-the-shoulder gowns with long skirts sit in front of a stage where several men play instruments in this horizontal pastel drawing. They all have pale skin and brown or black hair. Across the stage from us, the women’s gowns are petal pink, crimson red, butter yellow, baby or azure blue, or black, and they all wear black chokers around their necks. Their hair is swept up and tied with bows or ornaments to match their dresses. One woman holds a bouquet of flowers in her lap and two more hold fans, one open and one closed, to their mouths. Three women in the front row sit closely together and others turn or stand. The walls and possibly curtains of this space are luminous yellow, and a green palm-like tree is at the back of the room. The woman wearing black stands directly in front of the stage, one hand lifted and the other clasping her skirts as she leans toward the musicians. Her mouth is open, and she is harshly up-lit by the stage lights. Three men facing her hold a violin, upright bass, and perhaps a viola. Three more men closer to us face away so we only see the brown hair of one, the black top hat of another, and the straw-yellow bowler hat of the third. The stage space is enclosed opposite us with a wall streaked with kelly green, peacock blue, and charcoal gray. A three-lobed brass-colored light hangs or is affixed to the wall there. The artist signed the lower left, “Degas.”

artworks.title: Cephalus and Procris
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures in a detailed natural setting. One figure is standing, reaching out towards the other figure who is lying on the ground. The background includes lush foliage and trees. The drawing uses cross-hatching and intricate line work to convey depth and texture.

artworks.title: Horses Going to a Fair
artworks.description: This is an illustration of horses on a path near a stone structure. Three horses of different breeds are portrayed in detailed form, showcasing their various characteristics. One horse is primarily white with dark patches, a second one is a darker breed with a strong build, and the third is led by another horse carrying a large load on its back. In the background is a tall stone pillar against a slightly cloudy sky, enhancing the sense of depth. The drawing depicts the horses on a natural terrain and conveys a tranquil, rural atmosphere of movement and togetherness.

artworks.title: Dead Horse
artworks.description: The image shows a winter landscape with a fallen horse in the foreground, surrounded by snow. There are farm structures to the left, a bare tree, and a broken wheel partially buried in snow. Birds are flying above in the sky, adding to the wintery scene. The scene is depicted in shades of gray, white, and black, creating a cold and desolate atmosphere.

artworks.title: The Piper
artworks.description: The image displays an older man playing a bagpipe while standing with his back slightly turned. He holds the instrument against his chest with both hands. The man has a large nose and a long beard. He wears a high-crowned hat, a long coat, wrapped leg coverings, and shoes. A small dog on a leash walks beside him. The background depicts masonry and brick structures with buildings in the distance under a cloudy sky.

artworks.title: Dance Under the Trees
artworks.medium: etching in black on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape scene viewed from a slightly elevated point. The horizon is low, showing a textured landscape stretching into the distance. Intricate brushstrokes create texture and depth in the trees and ground. The monochromatic palette contrasts dark tones of trees and figures with lighter sky and background. A group of figures is near us, engaging in an activity under trees. Cows graze further off, adding to the scene. In the distance, the land slopes towards a misty horizon, hinting at hills or water.
